basis.quote: I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area.
basis.interpretation: 36-year-old male with acute contact dermatitis from poison ivy exposure, presenting with localized pruritic vesicular rash on bilateral forearms with mild progression within the affected area.
Patient denies systemic symptoms and respiratory compromise, reducing likelihood of severe allergic reaction or secondary infection at this time.

basis.quote: My friend once had tongue swelling and breathing trouble after a sting; that is not happening to me.
basis.interpretation: Patient explicitly denies angioedema or dyspnea; anaphylaxis is not currently present.

output.reason: Localized poison ivy dermatitis with pruritus and vesicles warrants clinician assessment for confirmation, severity grading, and treatment recommendations, but no emergency findings or acute systemic involvement is reported.
